title: Cardinality of the bounded-weight Pauli error set
statement:
For natural numbers $n$ and $t$, the number of Pauli strings of length $n$ whose weight is at most $t$ is
\[
|\mathcal{E}(n,t)| \;=\; \sum_{j=0}^{t} \binom{n}{j}\, 3^{\,j}.
\]
Here a Pauli string is a function $p : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \{I,X,Y,Z\}$, and its weight $\mathrm{wt}(p)$ is the number of coordinates $i$ with $p(i) \neq I$; the sum counts, for each $j \le t$, the $\binom{n}{j}$ choices of a weight-$j$ support together with the $3^{j}$ assignments of a non-identity Pauli to each chosen coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: n : ℕ (length of the Pauli strings)
